title: cli: one-shot secret paths (`os secret rewrap`, one-shot settings) still build their own LocalCryptoProvider, so they cannot open what `os serve` sealed with a registered provider
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cytLmJxfAmgPVjUbbW

Filing gate: ① a named location, from the contract review of PR #30993 (record 6689701608, should-fix S2) and the dev report on #30948 (comment 6689416308, out-of-scope finding). ⛔ Not a claim.

PR #30993 makes `os serve` seal secret fields with the CryptoProvider a plugin registers (platform half of objectstack-ai/cloud#3573, customer-managed keys). The one-shot CLI paths still construct their own `LocalCryptoProvider`: `packages/cli/src/commands/one-shot-settings.ts` and `os secret rewrap`. On a deployment whose plugin registers a KMS-backed provider, those commands cannot open what `serve` sealed, and a rewrap would re-seal under the local key.

Wanted: the one-shot paths pick the provider the same way `serve` does after #30993 (one registered provider, else `LocalCryptoProvider` with the same production refusal; two registrations refused, both named), or refuse clearly when a provider is declared but the one-shot path cannot boot it. Tests mirror the #30993 ones.

Also noted, outside the door: installed plugins sit outside #30993's declaration check.

Suggested grade: p2, `domain:server`. Serial: after PR #30993 lands. Carrier: objectstack-ai/cloud#3573.
